amase-erasmus-mundus-2027.about:
AMASE is an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master (EMJM) in Advanced Materials Science and Engineering. A materials science and engineering master's taught at two of six European technical universities, with full and partial Erasmus Mundus scholarships for 2027. It is coordinated by Saarland University (European School of Materials) in Saarbrücken (Germany); the consortium: Saarland University (Germany), Luleå University of Technology (Sweden), UPC Barcelona (Spain), Université de Lorraine (France), Montanuniversität Leoben (Austria) and University of Padua (Italy); students take two of them and study in two languages. Students move between partner universities and graduate with a joint or multiple degree.

Who it is for: Bachelor's in materials science, physics, chemistry, mechanical or process engineering or related; English proficiency and basics of a second programme language as required by the chosen universities (see application requirements). Applicants of any nationality can apply, including citizens of Georgia and Qatar.
